entities.summary: Jorge Vargas (b. 1967-02-08, Pichilemu) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Pichilemu and Chile. Known in the fields of chile, composers & musicians, americas.
